leakage.test: near-duplicate / n-gram overlap between training material and the sealed set above threshold; held-out implausibly above train

undetectable.test: gap to floor < MDE at test_n
undetectable.note: professor blocker; nothing else is worth trying until the floor can be verified

label-noise-limited.test: annotator agreement < floor, or held-out plateaus below floor with train/held-out gap small and confident-learning flag rate > 3%
label-noise-limited.note: fix labels before any training lever

distribution-shifted.test: per-source or per-capture breakdown diverges from per-stratum by more than seed_sd × 3; production condition differs from calibration material

data-limited.test: curve still rising at the last volume (slope > 0.5 × first-segment slope) and train/held-out gap small

overfit.test: train/held-out gap > 2 × seed_sd and growing with volume

method-limited.test: curve flat (slope < 0.25 × first-segment slope) with small gap and clean labels

comparison_rule: the recipe seat's single comparison is the highest-expected-effect lever for the binding stratum's diagnosed cause, run with-vs-without; the optimizer comparison is the default only when the cause is method-limited and rank and schedule are settled
